233|f729d74e.name: Farmer Saldean
233|f729d74e.text: Rough times, huh, $N? No matter where you turn someone needs help, and my wife and I are no exception.

2456|105cd232.name: Newton Burnside
2456|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2456|2237a3b1.name: Newton Burnside
2456|2237a3b1.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us sir?

268047|c401ba80.name: Theramore Emissary
268047|c401ba80.text: $N, the Stormpike Guard is in need of your aid in the battle against the Frostwolf Clan in Alterac Valley, now more than ever.  The opportunities for honor and repute are greater than ever as well! Will you join the battle?

268568|f87f742d.name: Roy Lewells
268568|f87f742d.text: Literacy should be celebrated and shared.

392|9183bb21.name: Captain Grayson
392|9183bb21.text: Do not be alarmed, $r.  I have long since passed from this land but I intend no harm to your kind.  I have witnessed too much death in my time.  My only wish now is for peace.  Perhaps you can help my cause.

4218|34f0a84a.name: Denatharion
4218|34f0a84a.text:
Welcome, my sister.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

There are rumors of strife within the Cenarion Circle, but you should pay such loose talk no heed.  Our Arch $C, Fandral Staghelm, leads us and all of Teldrassil to glory!

4219|34f0a84a.name: Fylerian Nightwing
4219|34f0a84a.text:
Welcome, my sister.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

There are rumors of strife within the Cenarion Circle, but you should pay such loose talk no heed.  Our Arch $C, Fandral Staghelm, leads us and all of Teldrassil to glory!

4262|5a295268.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|5a295268.text: Another material girl are we?  Well, if you are obsessed with your precious items then you will probably want to store them at the Darnassus Bank in the center of our city.

4262|96761fec.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|96761fec.text: In grizzly times a $c can be a dear friend to those around them.  Ask any of the druids in the Cenarion Enclave and they will tell you the same.

4262|e07232c6.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|e07232c6.text: Here among the craftsmen of Darnassus, there is a millenium of knowledge for the benefit of your chosen craft.  Now tell me, which craft do you find the most intriguing?

523|d6469a91.name: Thor
523|d6469a91.text: Where are you going?  Well if you're looking to get there quickly, then look no further!

103-accept.name: Captain Grayson
103-accept.text:
The night the Lighthouse Keeper's family died was horrible.  I watched, helpless, as Old Murk-Eye led the attack.  But what's done is done and now my concern is for the lives of the sailors on The Great Sea whose ships come close to the perilous rocks of the coastline.  With no one to keep watch on the flame the responsibility has fallen upon me.

Help me keep the torch lit by bringing me 5 flasks of oil from the Harvest Monsters.
103-accept.title: Keeper of the Flame

103-complete.name: Captain Grayson
103-complete.text:
Praise you, brave $C.  The rocks of the Westfall Coast shall be lit thanks to your hard work.  Many lives will be spared so long as the torch is kept lit.

I died needlessly on this very shore.  My afterlife plight is to see that no others follow my destiny.
103-complete.title: Keeper of the Flame

103-progress.name: Captain Grayson
103-progress.text: The flame will not burn for long without oil, $N.
103-progress.title: Keeper of the Flame

104-accept.name: Captain Grayson
104-accept.text:
When my life was ended upon the rocks, I had no clue what the afterlife held for me.  The Lighthouse was black that night because Old Murk-Eye had scared the keeper's family off.  They returned and re-lit the flame but Old Murk-Eye coerced the weaker minded murlocs to raid the Lighthouse with him once again.  The second time the family was not so lucky and before my eyes they perished helplessly.

Slay Old Murk-Eye if you see him along the shore and bring me one of his scales and I shall reward you.
104-accept.title: The Coastal Menace

139-complete.name: Unknown
139-complete.text: You're on your way to the jackpot, treasure seeker!
139-complete.title: Captain Sander's Hidden Treasure

140-accept.name: Unknown
140-accept.text: Sure enough, deep within the Old Jug there is another clue to Sander's treasure.  The ink has run in some places and the paper smells like whiskey but you can make out some of the text:  Now that ye found me ol' whiskey jug, you're almost to the treasure!  Just face West from the bottle and walk down to the shore.  Once ye get to the water, keep going!  Swim straight west till you find the island with me treasure chest!
140-accept.title: Captain Sander's Hidden Treasure

140-complete.name: Unknown
140-complete.text:
The hinges on the old chest are rusty but they still work.  You force the chest open and take the booty.

Congratulations!
140-complete.title: Captain Sander's Hidden Treasure

152-accept.name: Captain Grayson
152-accept.text:
You probably noticed all of the shipwrecks along the coast.  The Great Sea is treacherous indeed.  The coast of Westfall needs to be kept clear, so that if sailors find their way to our beaches, they are safe.  The Murlocs are trouble though.

Kill 7 Tidehunters, 7 Warriors, 7 Oracles and 7 Coastrunners and I will see to it that you are rewarded.
152-accept.title: The Coast Isn't Clear

26-accept.name: Mathrengyl Bearwalker
26-accept.text:
$N, I have been following your progress with much delight.  You are most assuredly developing yourself into a valued protector of nature.

The time has come for you to learn more about one of the various animal aspects that Cenarius has blessed us with the ability to change into - one that affords you command and mastery of the water.  For this, you must travel to the village of Nighthaven in Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze of the Cenarion Circle there.  He will guide you further.
26-accept.title: A Lesson to Learn

97237-progress.name: Roy Lewells
97237-progress.text: You forgot what you had to do the moment you stepped through the door, eh? Happens to everyone.
97237-progress.title: Shelf Picked

98393-accept.name: Mathrengyl Bearwalker
98393-accept.text:
It would seem that you are ready for the next step in your journey, young $c. Dendrite Starblaze has sent for you, and wishes for you to seek him out in Moonglade once again.

You have already learned to call upon the magic to take you to Moonglade, so you should be able to embark immediately if you choose. I would suggest you leave soon, if you wish to continue your druidic training.
98393-accept.title: The Great Cat Spirit
